H1.falsification: A target slice fails the practical-margin decision rule.

H2.direction: B wrong rate <= A wrong rate + 2 percentage points
H2.falsification: B's dangerous definite-error rate exceeds the ceiling.

H3.direction: Qwen3-4B B accuracy within 10 percentage points of C
H3.falsification: C minus B exceeds 10 percentage points.

H4.direction: A accuracy decreases monotonically with fact count/depth; B stays flat
H4.analysis: For each predeclared family and evidence-fit condition, order size/depth strata ascending. Compare adjacent A strata using paired per-instance differences when construction-index groups correspond, otherwise independent stratified bootstrap. An A increase is a violation only if its 95% lower bound is positive. For B, flat means the accuracy point estimate in every larger/deeper stratum is no more than 10 percentage points below the smallest/shallowest stratum; report the uncertainty for each contrast. A missing size/depth stratum makes H4 not evaluated, not passed.
H4.falsification: An A adjacent contrast increases beyond uncertainty, or any B stratum degrades by more than 10 percentage points.

decision_rule.condition: Evidence fits only; capped-evidence rows reported separately, never a reasoning win.

multiplicity_policy: Family-specific 95% intervals are unadjusted and labelled as such; there is no pooled win or any-family confirmatory claim. H1 is an intersection-union claim: every predeclared target (F2, F3, F4, F7 depth>=3 and F9) must satisfy the practical-margin rule. H2 must hold in each target. All size/depth and dev-pilot comparisons are descriptive; a successful subset never establishes H1.
